folds.heading: ## Current-use reconciliation B128, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full G1–G7/GF1–GF31/DP1–DP6 and all housing/people/places variants read. Word counts are dated gallery-fixture/default-view measurements, not native play, comprehension or usability proof. The audit correctly separates cuts from hiding duplicate text and cuts against drawing-only content; neither establishes that fewer words always communicate the required decision. Its “known” reference label means the author could describe a recalled mechanism, not a newly authenticated external game audit. Screenshots, HTML/source fixtures and capture evidence were not separately reviewed here.

Later direction governs use: [DESIGN selective 2D](../../DESIGN.md#selective-2d-exploration-2026-11-01) prioritizes functional Proto23-style housing and stops expansion of the pictured-home experiment. Current [vision digest](../VISION_DIGEST.md) also preserves prose-first editorial defaults and optional deliberate illustration. The original floor plan was rejected within this audit, and subsequent H1/H2/H3 picks remain proposals rather than a mandate to restart housing imagery. Keep spatial forms where position/layout/reach/adjacency serves a selected task. DP1 hidden-text, DP2 object-per-system, DP3 type voices and DP5 hidden inventory are not universal current rules; preserve useful independent panels, explicit costs/next action and reachable accessible detail. The historical ui-identity lane owned implementation files, not creative authority to accept new product direction.

Preserve the useful palette: one clear task question, fewer repeated facts, world-qualified motifs, accessible text alternatives, coherent state/unit labels and comparative variants. Do not infer unknown people/kin/traits from empty slots or a traced chain from private truth. F2’s seven ancestry slots are an example, not a universal family shape; a three-day loop dial and five-minute travel blocks are local presentation choices, not shared time laws. GF7’s combined threat needs actual action timing/means rather than an unqualified sum. GF27’s ticket/tags cannot replace actual carrier, custody and world-support rules. Housing’s invented locked-room prerequisite and fitting placement, hand-shortened NEXT_ASK strings, missing pursuit distances and undrawn overlays/settled states remain explicit mock limitations.

Hover-only gates, unlabeled pips, fixed-size counted beds and color/position-dependent meaning need real keyboard, zoom, text and model evidence if selected. Dated word counts, two skins, all-row coverage or a stylesheet fix do not prove every production panel, data provider or player route. Keep all original variants/history in place; no new UI implementation, style change, art request, work wave or priority was selected. Current active UI/prose/foundation writers retain their own files and receipts.
